g.text: Each sensor uses 3.3V Pull-up with 10kΩ Pull-down to GND
6-Axis Gyroscope + Accelerometer for Wrist Rotation & Flexion
✓ GY-521 includes onboard 4.7kΩ pull-up resistors on SDA & SCL directly to 3.3V.
Master Hardware Map configured in sleeve_firmware.ino
★ NOTE: ADC1 pins (32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 39) function simultaneously with Wi-Fi.
